svg.title: Algorithm illustrated for children
svg.desc: A cheerful illustration showing three everyday "algorithms" as step-by-step picture sequences: bedtime routine, making a sandwich, and drawing a cat.
svg.text: An algorithm is just a list of steps to do something!
Each of these is an algorithm — a list of steps, done in order, to get to a goal.
Opal might draw her cat differently than you do. That's her algorithm! 🐾
